# Help and troubleshooting

[Back to the app overview](../README.md) · [Downloads and release notes](https://github.com/KeKKERUUU/RandomEverywhereCompanion/releases)

## Before reporting a problem

Check the release notes for your version, then search the [existing reports](https://github.com/KeKKERUUU/RandomEverywhereCompanion/issues). If someone has the same problem, add your details there rather than opening a duplicate.

You do not need to build the app, run scripts or provide a code change to ask for help.

## No mission audio

1. Check whether you selected recorded soundpacks or synthetic voices.
2. Make sure the selected pack or voice is installed.
3. Check the output device, Windows volume and the app's volume and mute settings.
4. Save any changed audio settings before testing.
5. For audio during a mission, check the simulator connection as well.

Recorded packs and synthetic voices are separate. Tell us which mode you used and whether the problem affects a preview, mission playback or both. For loud or missing alerts, include the alert type and relevant volume settings.

## Missing packages or failed updates

Check the selected simulator and Community folder. Keep the original package archive, the error message and any backup or recovery files the app reports. Do not delete recovery data or overwrite files manually just to clear an error.

Close MSFS before installing or updating simulator packages or applying offline maintenance. Tell us the package name, its version if known, and which operation failed. Do not upload the package itself.

## Antivirus warning

Keep the detection name, application version, affected file name and download source. A screenshot can help after personal paths have been hidden. Include a file hash if you already have one; it is not required to report a problem.

Do not disable your antivirus, add exclusions or restore a quarantined file just to test it. A warning needs investigation; it is not automatically a false positive.

## Send a useful report

Choose [Report a problem](https://github.com/KeKKERUUU/RandomEverywhereCompanion/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). Include:

- Your Companion version, Windows version and MSFS version, if known.
- What you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead.
- The error text and a screenshot or short relevant log excerpt, if available.

Screenshots and logs are optional. Use the app's diagnostics or log controls if available; no terminal commands are required.

Everything posted in an issue is public. Remove usernames, personal folder paths, email addresses, tokens and other private details. Never upload commercial packages, voice-model archives or a complete copy of your data folder.

To propose a change, use [Suggest an improvement](https://github.com/KeKKERUUU/RandomEverywhereCompanion/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) and describe what you want to do during normal use. You do not need to design the implementation.

## Further reading

The [documentation index](../docs/README.md) also links to the optional advanced reference and source build instructions. Neither is required to install or use the app.
